### last time {.smaller}

*  page tables
   *  divide virtual [program]/physical [real] memory into fixed-sized pages
   *  number pages starting at 0
   *  table: virtual page $X \rightarrow$ physical page $Y$
   *  valid bits --- indicate page table entry has no physical page
*  allocating memory on demand
   *  OS gets control on page fault (using invalid memory)
   *  update page table + retry on page fault
*  permission bits
   *  sharing memory as read-only
*  copy-on-write
